summary: On June 17, 2026, TriNet Group, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a $0.29 per share quarterly dividend on its common stock. The record and ex-dividend date is July 1, 2026, with a payout on July 27, 2026. The board approved the dividend; no advisor is named. The filing is a routine capital return event under Item 8.01. No other special-situation characteristics are present. Watch for future dividend declarations as part of TriNet's ongoing capital allocation strategy.
